run_dataset_preprocess: run the coyo 1M dataset preprocessing script to download images and generate canny edge conditioning images
filter_dataset_function: filter a HuggingFace dataset by clip similarity, watermark score, and aesthetic score thresholds
preprocess_and_save_images: preprocess dataset examples by downloading images, applying canny edge detection, and saving metadata to JSONL
parse_args_preprocessing: parse command line arguments for train data directory, cache directory, max samples, and number of processors
estimate_filter_ratio: estimate the dataset filter ratio using a sample of 20000 examples to calculate required max training samples
